sources.entry: Other Awesome lists: Awesome Big Data, Awesome Public Datasets

summary.one_liner: A curated awesome-list of big data frameworks, databases, tools and learning resources, organized by category, with a one-line description per entry.
summary.what_it_does: This is a link list rather than software: it catalogs big data projects and resources under headings such as RDBMS, Frameworks, Distributed Programming, Distributed Filesystem, Key-value, Graph, Columnar, NewSQL, Time-Series, Lakehouse Table Formats, SQL-like processing, Vector Databases, Data Ingestion, Data Quality, Scheduling, Machine Learning, Benchmarking, Security and System Deployment. Each entry is a name followed by a short description, and some sections include notes that explain terminology, such as the distinction between key-map and column-store "columnar databases". The README is truncated, so the listing after System Deployment, along with the Interesting Readings, Papers, Videos, Books and Other Awesome Lists sections, is not visible here. The list links to other projects and does not itself include code or install steps.
use_cases: Finding a big data framework or database for a specific workload
Comparing options in a category such as stream processing or time-series storage
Locating vector databases for similarity search
Browsing Hadoop and Spark ecosystem tools
Finding data ingestion and ETL tools
Discovering big data benchmarks and data quality tools
notable: Broad taxonomy covering storage, processing, ingestion, ML, security and deployment in one list
Includes explanatory notes distinguishing the two meanings of 'columnar databases'
Entries are short one-line descriptions, making it quick to scan
Recent additions cover lakehouse table formats and vector databases
caveats: Link list only; entries are not verified or maintained to the same level as the linked projects
README is truncated, so later sections are not visible in this summary
Some entries are historical or discontinued projects, and the list mixes open source with commercial and cloud services
keywords: choose a database for big data
